fp fq fr qu fs ft fu qv fv fw qw cv" data-selectable-paragraph="">About ChatGPT</h3><p id="ce67" class="pw-post-body-paragraph pf pg kc ph b pi qx pk pl pm qy po pp fo qz pr ps fr ra pu pv fu rb px py pz iv cv" data-selectable-paragraph="">ChatGPT is a large language model created by OpenAI that is based on the GPT-3.5 architecture. It was launched on November 30, 2022 with an aim to understand and generate natural language text, making it possible for people to interact with computers and machines in a more intuitive and conversational manner. ChatGPT has been trained on a massive corpus of text data from a variety of sources, allowing it to generate high-quality responses to a wide range of prompts and questions. ChatGPT is intended to be a powerful tool for a variety of applications, such as customer service, education, and research.</p><h3 id="e8c3" class="qo qp kc z qq fk qr ao fl fm qs aq fn fo qt fp fq fr qu fs ft fu qv fv fw qw cv" data-selectable-paragraph="">Problem Statement</h3><p id="03ef" class="pw-post-body-paragraph pf pg kc ph b pi qx pk pl pm qy po pp fo qz pr ps fr ra pu pv fu rb px py pz iv cv" data-selectable-paragraph="">The current web interface of ChatGPT lacks intuitive navigation and fails to provide users with an easy way to generate and share results. This leads to a suboptimal user experience. Since ChatGPT is a machine learning model, it is crucial for people to interact with it more so that it can receive data and improve its algorithm. This redesign project aims to improve user engagement, increase ease of use, and enhance user retention by creating a more user-friendly interface with new features that enable users to generate and share results with ease.</p><div class="xj et xk xl am j gh"><div class="xm xn xo xp xq e bv"><h2 class="xr b xs xt xu xv xw">Get Jahanvi Singh’s stories in your inbox</h2></div><div class="wx e bv"><p class="z b cr u w">Join Medium for free to get updates from this writer.</p></div><div class="ya te yb yc td yd am"><span class="z b cr u cv"><div class="ye am gh"><div class="am ye br bq jh yf yg ei go yh yi yj yk yl ym yn"><input class="yo ca by cb yp yq dx nn cw hp cs" placeholder="Enter your email" type="text" value=""></div></div></span><div class="ck cz tt ej"><div class="xx xy xz"><button class="z b cr u yr sj ys yt yu yv yw bk bl yx yy yz bp bq br bs bt bu bv">Subscribe</button></div></div><div class="cs da r s"><button class="z b cr u yr sj ys yt yu yv yw bk bl yx yy yz bp cs bq br bs bt bu bv">Subscribe</button></div></div><div class="ui e"><label class="am j"><div class="zn zo zp am vn ej dm"><input class="za zb zc dr hd zd ze zf zg zh zi zj" type="checkbox" checked=""><span class="j zk zl bq br ip bs yr af am ys zm ew" data-checkbox="true"><svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 11 11" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="ys"><path d="M0 6.313L3.704 10.018L4.608 10.922L5.268 9.827L10.564 1.032L8.85 0L3.554 8.795L5.117 8.604L1.413 4.899L0 6.313Z"></path></svg></span></div><div class="e"><p class="z b cr u cv">Remember me for faster sign in</p></div></label></div><div class="ug e"><div id="g-recaptcha"></div></div></div><p id="7108" class="pw-post-body-paragraph pf pg kc ph b pi pk pl pm po pp fo pr ps fr pu pv fu px py xl pz iv cv" data-selectable-paragraph="">From a business impact perspective, the redesign will encourage users to interact more with ChatGPT.
